Generator
==========

Start up procedure
------------
1. Check if the generator is operational (fuel, filter, cooling,...)
2. Make sure that the exhaust fume can't trigger any fires!
2. Set the Panda into auto start mode:
    - at the pandas panel, press the power button
    - 3s later press down
    - scroll down to autostart
    - enable/disable autostart with start/stop button
    - wait a few seconds
    - turn panda panel off




Changing the battery fill level to start and stop the generator
------------

At the BMV2 (in the battery cabinet, the lower device with display):

 1. Hold setup for 2s to enter the setup mode
 1. Navigate to entry 64 (Lock Setup) and press select, change the "Lock Setup" to OFF using +/- and confirm by pressing select
 1. Return to the main menu by briefly pressing setup
 1. Navigate to entry 16 (SOC delay), press select, change the "SOC delay" to the desired percentage with +/- to start the generator and confirm by pressing select
 1. Return to the main menu by briefly pressing setup
 1. Navigate to entry 17 (Clear SOC delay), press select, change the "Clear SOC delay" to the desired percentage with +/- to stop the generator and confirm by pressing select
 1. Return to the main menu by briefly pressing setup
 1. Navigate to entry 64 (Lock Setup) and press select, change the "Lock Setup" to ON using +/- and confirm by pressing select.
 1. Shortly press setup twice to leave the setup mode

Note: For best Battery live a value of SOC Delay Value of 35% and a Clear SOC delay of 95% is recommended. All successful changes are acknowledged with a short piping noise. 

Changing the battery value to turn everything off using the TBS (Battery protect)
------
At the BMV1 (in the battery cabinet, the upper device with display):

 1. Hold setup for 2s to enter the setup mode
 1. Navigate to entry 64 (Lock Setup) and press select, change the "Lock Setup" to OFF using +/- and confirm by pressing select
 1. Return to the main menu by briefly pressing setup
 1. Navigate to entry 16 (SOC delay), press select, change the "SOC delay" to the desired percentage with +/- to trigger the TBS and confirm by pressing select
 1. Return to the main menu by briefly pressing setup
 1. Navigate to entry 17 (Clear SOC delay), press select, change the "Clear SOC delay" to the desired percentage with +/- to release the TBS and confirm by pressing select
 1. Return to the main menu by briefly pressing setup
 1. Navigate to entry 64 (Lock Setup) and press select, change the "Lock Setup" to ON using +/- and confirm by pressing select.
 1. Shortly press setup twice to leave the setup mode

Note: For best Battery live a value of SOC Delay Value of 20% and a Clear SOC delay of 25% is recommended. All successful changes are acknowledged with a short piping noise.
